audit.whatIsWrong: The layers rendered different answers for the first-item and two-item rows: phases[5..6].side = Yone while win[5..6] = Aurelion Sol.
audit.why: At 50.34% over 872 games with Yone owning 1 through 6, the item stages are where Aurelion Sol turns it. The content layer is right; the full layer never got updated.
audit.corrected: Yone / Yone / Yone / Yone / Yone / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol, with phases[5] and phases[6] flipped to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole content layer describes the pre-rework Aurelion Sol: 'Starsurge', 'Comet of the Legend', 'Comet', 'Voice of Light', '5-star', and repeated references to a Q stun.
audit.why: The current kit is Breath of Light (Q, a 3s-cooldown channelled beam), Astral Flight (W), the black hole (E) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R). There is no stun on Q at all, so advice built on 'land a stunned Q' is unfollowable.
audit.corrected: Every spike, the prose fields and the wants[] rebuilt on the real kit, with Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10s, Spirit Cleave 14s and Fate Sealed 120/100/80s as the concrete timings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The shield was attributed to Yone's passive, and the decisive channel interaction was never stated.
audit.why: Yone's passive is Way of the Hunter (magic damage every second attack plus crit chance); the shield is Spirit Cleave (W) on a flat 14s cooldown scaling with attack speed. The interaction that decides the lane is that two Mortal Steel stacks turn his next Q into a dash plus knockup, and any CC cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight — so the channel dies to a Q he can throw from 450 units. Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls, which drags you out of your own black hole.
audit.corrected: Written into early, spikes[0], spikes[1], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and enemyWin.

edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks dash in with a knockup that cancels Breath of Light, and Spirit Cleave shields the chip — you have no answer until 6.

edits.before: Your uncapped scaling and 5-star Voice of Light poke outclass his falloff damage in teamfights where he can't isolate you.
edits.after: Your uncapped Stardust and The Skies Descend outclass his falloff damage in teamfights where he cannot isolate you at all.

edits.before: Yone's E-Q-W combo lets him dash in, poke, and dash back out before your Starsurge windup finishes, so levels 1-5 he's landing free trades while you're mostly kiting and eating minion aggro. His passive shield absorbs your poke attempts, and he out-trades you in extended fights since you have no hard peel until Comet is off cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Unbound sends his spirit in, deals its damage, then snaps him back to safety on a 22-second cooldown at rank 1, so levels 1-5 he trades for free while you kite. Spirit Cleave shields him every 14 seconds, and the knockup off two Mortal Steel stacks cancels your channel outright, so you have no peel at all until Falling Star at 6.

edits.before: Level 6 is still his window — Fate Sealed synergizes with Yone's dash mobility to close the gap and burst you if you're caught pushed up, and your ult travels too slowly to threaten his escape. Play patient, freeze near tower, and only commit Starsurge when he's already spent his E dash so he can't just walk it off.
edits.after: Level 6 is still his window — Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone back to him, so being caught pushed up means being dragged under his tower. Play patient, freeze near your own, and only start the beam once Soul Unbound is spent: he has 22 seconds at rank 1 with no way back to his body.

edits.before: Once you finish your first item, Aurelion Sol's poke range and stun uptime start winning neutral exchanges outright, and by two items your teamfight presence (Voice of Light barrage plus Falling Star execute) outscales anything Yone can burst through. Play for these later stages — you don't need to win lane, just survive it.
edits.after: Once you finish your first item, Aurelion Sol's beam range and Falling Star uptime start winning neutral exchanges outright, and by two items your teamfight presence (The Skies Descend dragging his front line into a black hole execute) outscales anything Yone can burst through. Play for these later stages — you don't need to win lane, just survive it.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Astral Flight for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: 22/19/16/13/10s — while his spirit is out his body is parked, so beam the body and leave before the snapback lands. - Spirit Cleave shields every 14s: force it, then trade. - Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by scaling honestly — Stardust is permanent, and Yone's snapback damage is fixed while your beam simply never stops growing.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn Yone on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, punish the spirit: when Soul Unbound leaves, his body cannot move — drop the black hole onto it, beam it, and be gone long before he snaps back in.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Yone wins by knocking you out of the beam with Mortal Steel, then shielding through everything you had left.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks means his next Q dashes and knocks up — that is when your channel dies.

edits.before: Yone whiffs Soul Unbound and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Yone spends Fate Sealed elsewhere — the next minute is yours.

notes: This matchup's content layer was written for the pre-rework Aurelion Sol end to end — Starsurge, Comet of the Legend, Voice of Light, '5-star', and advice to 'land a stunned Q' when the current Q has no stun. All of it replaced with the live kit. Also corrected the shield attribution: Yone's passive is Way of the Hunter, the shield is Spirit Cleave (W).
